title: A buffer overflow when handling pointer barriers in the XFIXES extension in X.Org X server before 21.1.25 and XWayland…
description: A buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the handling of pointer barriers in the XFIXES extension of the X.Org X server before version 21.1.25 and XWayland before version 24.1.14. Authenticated X clients could exploit this flaw to crash the X server or potentially execute arbitrary code within the X server context.
